summary: npm 12 returned an object from npm pack --json while the initial staging script expected an array; staging now accepts both shapes.
followUp: Keep the dual-shape parser and retain the staged artifact manifest.

summary: Sandboxed Vite build could not write node_modules/.vite-temp and failed with EROFS; the same build passed with filesystem permission.
followUp: Run UI build/test commands with writable node_modules access and record the environment requirement.

summary: ERPBridge documents cross-origin CORS only for /mcp/; REST management, invoke, cache, logs, metrics, and health calls remain same-origin/server-proxy operations.
followUp: Keep browser SDK verification limited to MCP/tools and route REST through the Node BFF.

summary: The onboarding generator emits multi-document YAML that bridgectl tool apply cannot consume reliably; existing per-tool JSON schemas are the reproducible seed input.
followUp: Run and record the documented path when relevant, but seed the verification stack from ERPBridge/schemas/erp/*.json.

summary: Docker Compose could not fetch the GHCR UV builder image or Docker Hub Go builder image because registry authorization/EOF errors occurred before service startup.
followUp: Use the documented host-process fallback for SDK/MCP/REST coverage and retry Compose after registry access is restored.

summary: The SDK browser-safe version global was defined for regular Vitest tests but not the separate live integration config, causing both integration suites to crash before executing.
followUp: Patch vitest.integration.config.ts with the same package-version define and rerun the live suite.

summary: Browser MCP failed because the existing ERPBridge binary lacked the source-level MCP-Protocol-Version CORS allowance; rebuilding from commit 2137644 fixed the stale runtime artifact.
followUp: Build and preflight-check the selected ERPBridge revision before browser tests.

summary: The live BFF integration test used fixed port 8787 and collided with the manually running BFF; the test now uses an ephemeral port and guarded cleanup.
The BFF SSE integration test waited for an event without producing a new server operation; it now invokes a seeded tool after subscribing.
evidence: Verbose Vitest run stalled after three passed live BFF tests; .scratch/issues/2026-08-21T205640Z_bff-stream-test-sequencing.md
followUp: Keep SSE tests event-driven and bounded.

summary: Playwright could not launch because its cached headless-shell binary was missing; the expected full Chromium path was also absent when checked.
evidence: npm run test:e2e launcher error; .scratch/issues/2026-08-21T211100Z_playwright-headless-shell.md; superseded by UI-20260821-011
followUp: Provision a pinned Playwright browser; use the corrected launchOptions path when a browser is available.

summary: The Playwright Chromium download stalled at 0% and was interrupted, so no browser executable is available for e2e tests.
followUp: Provision the browser cache or rerun in a network-enabled CI environment before e2e sign-off.

summary: The Vite page requested a missing favicon and produced a browser console 404; an empty data favicon link now prevents the request.
followUp: Add branded favicon assets if the UI receives production branding.

summary: The automated Playwright config used an absent managed-browser path while Playwright CLI used system Chromium successfully; the config now supports an environment path and system fallback.
evidence: npm run test:e2e launcher error; running Playwright CLI Chromium process; .scratch/issues/2026-08-21T220130Z_playwright-system-browser-path.md
followUp: Set PLAYWRIGHT_EXECUTABLE_PATH in CI when needed.
